description: Saves video defaults on the person's Reel-E account, used by every chat app and the Reel-E create wizard: the song tempo (calm, steady or upbeat) or one song (a musicId from list_songs), pace (cinematic, fast or flow), branding (saved or none), videoPhotoCount, voiceover (on means each new listing video uses voiceover credits) and captions (only with a voiceover). Call it only after the person said yes to saving. Send only what to save or change; clear removes saved choices.

branding.description: saved uses the account's brand kit; none leaves out the contact card and logo.

captions.description: true shows captions on videos with a voiceover.

clear.description: Saved choices to remove: song, pace, branding, videoPhotoCount, voiceover, captions.

musicId.description: One song to use every time: a musicId from list_songs. Not with songTempo.

pace.description: The edit's pace: cinematic, fast or flow.

songTempo.description: The song tempo: calm, steady or upbeat (a different song of it each listing).

videoPhotoCount.description: How many photos the video uses, up to the account's photo limit.

voiceover.description: true makes a voiceover on each new listing video, using voiceover credits.

name: save_video_defaults
title: Save video defaults
